rules.accepted_credit_types: Programs from ADHA-affiliated or ADA/NDA-affiliated associations, accredited dental hygiene or dental schools, or Board-approved sponsors; required BLS course and other courses required by statute/rule count. Categories (OAC 4715-8-01): dental education/scientific courses unlimited (incl. ethics, regulatory compliance, risk management); non-clinical practice management max 5 h; papers/presentations max 3 h; teaching/research max 3 h; volunteer clinical service up to one-third; poster sessions max 2 h. Formats: directly interactive or supervised self-instruction with test (pass 75%).
rules.alternatives: Board may excuse for unusual circumstance, emergency or hardship: exemptions for recent graduates in their first registration and full-time students; extensions for military, health (max 1 year) or lost records; waivers when precluded from active practice.
rules.audit_note: Certify on the registration application; keep records at least 4 years; random or for-cause documentation requests.

topics.who: Required BLS course; counts toward CE

rules.notes: License valid two years from issuance (biennial registration fee $144). Basic life-support training required (ORC 4715.251) and counts toward the 20 hours.
